findings.message:
Require a separator before issue references

The optional whitespace and optional colon allow a zero-width separator. For example, `References ubiquity/fixes#123` is rewritten to `References ubiquity/#123`, treating a repository named `fixes` as a closing keyword; URL fragments such as `https://example.test/fixes#123` are similarly corrupted. Require an actual whitespace or colon separator.
